name: PROTOCOL_v3_exploratory
status: EXPLORATORY. Post-confirmatory robustness block. Registered before sessions S1-S3 were run. Nothing here can change the confirmatory decisions of PROTOCOL_v2 (V1-V4, all rejected).
motivation: Anticipated reviewer questions: (1) classic local/segment kick (Applegate et al. 2003) as baseline; (2,3) dependence on the time budget; (4) sensitivity to the development-chosen pool rule; (5) when does targeting help (instance structure).

common.start_tour_and_kick_seeds: as in PROTOCOL_v2 (seed s -> same start tour and kick RNG for every arm)
common.statistics: paired mean difference in percentage points, 10000-sample bootstrap 95% CI (seed 0), Wilcoxon signed-rank, Holm within each family, Hodges-Lehmann estimate, alpha 0.05
common.driver: v4_robustness_experiment.py (reuses the hash-registered v2_targeting_experiment.task; raw length = scorer swap as in v3_extra_experiment.py)

1_S1_local.local_geometry: first cut anywhere (or from the pool with prob p), the other two within W=50 tour positions
family: excess_global@0.06:0.5 - random_local (primary question: does the targeted global kick beat the classic segment kick?)

2_anytime.data: existing holdout2_10s runs (PROTOCOL_v2 confirmatory run, trace checkpoints 0.1..10 s)
2_anytime.analysis: each of the 7 targeting strategies - random_global at every checkpoint (bootstrap CI, Wilcoxon), descriptive only
2_anytime.note: uses already-observed data; computed while preparing this protocol, therefore descriptive, not predictive

3_S2_60s.extra: TOST non-inferiority excess vs gnn at 60 s with the PROTOCOL_v2 margin 0.05 (descriptive)

family: each of the 4 off-centre rules - random_global
each of the 4 off-centre rules - excess_global@0.06:0.5

5_structure.index: coefficient of variation of the nearest-neighbour distance (cv_nn)
5_structure.analysis: Spearman cv_nn vs per-instance (excess - random) and (excess - gnn); Spearman log n vs (excess - random)
5_structure.note: uses already-observed data; computed while preparing this protocol, therefore descriptive

reporting: All items are reported in the paper as exploratory, whatever their direction; null or adverse results are reported as scope limits.
